h1: When do you need a special permit for an ADU in Newton, MA?
title: Newton ADU Special Permits: Larger Units and Local Exceptions
description: Compare Newton's standard by-right ADU size with the larger-unit paths that require a special permit or specific conditions.
short_answer: Newton's standard by-right ADU limit is 1,000 square feet or 50% of the principal dwelling's total gross floor area, whichever is smaller. Newton lists a special-permit path for a detached ADU up to 1,500 square feet and for certain internal units up to 1,200 square feet. The exact pathway depends on the unit type and the property conditions.

facts.text: Newton allows a standard new internal or detached ADU by right up to 1,000 square feet or 50% of the primary residence's total floor area, whichever is smaller.
Newton identifies detached ADUs up to 1,500 square feet and certain internal ADUs up to 1,200 square feet as special-permit cases.

qa.q: Does every ADU larger than 1,000 square feet need the same type of special permit?
qa.a: No. Newton distinguishes between internal and detached units and lists conditions for some units between 1,000 and 1,200 square feet. Confirm the proposed unit type and property history.
